surnameSegmentation.behavior: Return every indexed prefix segmentation; do not calculate surname-based results unless explicit or unique.

characterElements.behavior: Use source attribution only; missing values remain unknown.

characterReading.behavior: Pinyin is not context-resolved for polyphonic characters; definitions are dictionary glosses.

longGivenNameExtension.scope: Given-name portion longer than two characters; report as an extension, not a universal classical convention.

taiwanKangxi.fiveGrid: single surname: surname stroke + 1; compound surname: surname sum; person: final surname character + first given character; single given character: stroke + 1; multi-character given name: given stroke sum; outer: heaven + earth - person; total: full name sum wrapped to 1..81
taiwanKangxi.threeTalents: element from final digit: 1/2 wood, 3/4 fire, 5/6 earth, 7/8 metal, 9/0 water

modern.fiveGrid: same arithmetic as taiwanKangxi, using modern strokes

unsupported.zodiacRadicalAssociations: Not enabled: no reviewed complete source with confirmed redistribution rights and documented method.
unsupported.genderedStyles: Not enabled: current name-character pool does not carry validated gender or style metadata; preferences are not inferred.

optionalBirthDataLens.inputs: Only when explicitly supplied: date, sex, calendar, optional lunar leap-month flag and ziMode, and time/shichen or explicit unknown-hour choice
optionalBirthDataLens.behavior: Lists name characters whose dictionary element matches useful elements from the local Bazi calculation. Generation may use those elements as a soft ordering preference; no single compatibility score is calculated.
optionalBirthDataLens.privacy: Birth fields are calculated in-process and excluded from the LLM prompt. Without place coordinates, true-solar-time correction is not applied.

interpretiveNotice: These methods are traditional cultural conventions, not empirically validated predictors. Three-or-more-character given names are labeled as an extension because schools differ.
